title: Path Middleware MCP Collision
outcome_summary: Added a `skip_tools` parameter (type `frozenset[str]`, default `frozenset()`) to `PathNormalizationMiddleware` that short-circuits path rewriting for named tools. In `create_stage_node`, the skip set is derived dynamically from the `mcp_tools` objects (`frozenset(t.name for t in mcp_tools)`) so every MCP tool — present and future — is automatically excluded without any manual list maintenance. This fixes the root cause of the PM stage loop observed in the `2026-07-13-improved-dialogue-render` orchestrator run, where `ledger_initialize_project` received a virtual `/docs/agents/plans/…` path instead of the absolute host path.
